status_message: Independent scan completed: 17 candidates reviewed; 0 qualified, 3 watch, 10 economic rejections, 2 portfolio-concentration rejections, and 2 evidence-blocked.
portfolio_note: Independent scan: 17 candidates (9 tokens, 8 natural-resource equities). No execution-ready idea. AAVE is the strongest conditional WATCH; WATCH is research pending, not a buy signal.

evidence.methodology: Screened nine tokens and eight natural-resource equities against live personal/RRSP, Evolution/TFSA, Kraken and Alpaca exposures, published-history exclusions, adjacent structured quote bars, capitalization/supply, value capture, dilution, 3–12 month catalysts, permanent-loss risk and executable liquidity. Economic rejection, concentration, evidence-blocked and WATCH outcomes are distinct.

sources.note: Structured token price, capitalization, FDV, supply, volume and one-year change for nine candidates; the malformed zero-cap MKR response was evidence-blocked.
Structured adjacent valid daily bars and one-year series; seven additional equity symbols were checked through the same endpoint.
Primary token utility and buyback mechanics.
Dated revenue, buyback, emissions and treasury-runway evidence.
Issuer Q2 operating, funding and production evidence dated August 6, 2026.

ideas.name: Aave
ideas.snapshot: US$154.48; US$2.383b market cap / US$2.472b FDV; -42.2% one year; US$257.1m reported 24h volume; CoinGecko 2026-09-28T00:01:10.000Z.
ideas.thesis: Aave has near-full circulation, large protocol usage and a governance-approved revenue-funded buyback. The mechanism is real, but acquired tokens are retained for governance-approved uses rather than burned.
ideas.risk: Not execution-ready: sustainable borrow-fee revenue has softened, current buyback execution and venue-specific slippage were not fully verified, and treasury spending remains governance-dependent.
ideas.trigger: Upgrade only after a primary-source trailing-90-day recurring revenue series covers the buyback and operating budget, executed purchases remain continuous for 12 weeks, a dated 3–12 month catalyst is confirmed, and intended-size slippage is below 1%.
